answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 39958 Country: India Title: Can I know Hadi name is available in Islam or not? Please tell me can I keep this name for my cousin son or not Question: Can I know Hadi name is available in Islam or not? Please tell me can I keep this name for my cousin son or not? Answer ID: 39958 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1086/1086/M=1433) Hadi is among the beautiful names of Allah. You can keep the name of your bhatija as Abdul Hadi i.e. you should add Abd in the beginning. Do not name only Hadi. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
